function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a file from the filesystem

path.description: File path (relative to MCP working dir or absolute)

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file (creates directories)

path.description: File path (relative to MCP working dir or absolute)

function.name: set_working_dir
function.description: Set MCP working directory for relative file paths

function.name: get_working_dir
function.description: Get current MCP working directory

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web for real-time information

function.name: agent_mission
function.description: Execute a mission with all agents in parallel

function.name: agent_single
function.description: Execute with a single agent

function.name: get_memory
function.description: Retrieve session memory

function.name: read_ssot
function.description: Read the current SSOT.md (Single Source of Truth) file — contains auto-detected project info

function.name: append_syllabus
function.description: Append a knowledge entry to the project syllabus.md — the shared learning log ALL agents read (append-only; never overwrites). Use when you learn something new worth keeping.

source.description: Origin of the knowledge (Web Search / docs / code / ...)

keyPoints.description: Key takeaways (string is split on newlines/commas too)

project_dir.description: Project dir (defaults to current MCP working dir)

function.name: list_directory
function.description: List contents of a directory

path.description: Directory path (relative to MCP working dir or absolute)

function.name: open_browser
function.description: Open a file or URL in the default browser (uses xdg-open/open/start)

target.description: File path or URL to open in the browser (e.g., /abs/path/file.html or http://localhost:3000)

function.name: browse_cdp
function.description: Headless-browse a URL via Chrome DevTools Protocol over a PIPE (zero HTTP control channel — no port, no websocket). Fetches a page with headless Chrome and returns its text, HTML, title, or a screenshot. Use for reading local or remote web pages.

url.description: Absolute URL to open: http://, https:// or file://

action.description: What to return: text (default, readable page text) | html | title | screenshot (base64 png)

function.name: call_agent
function.description: Call another agent for a specific sub-task. Use when the task needs specialized knowledge from another agent (e.g., security review, bug hunting, performance tuning).

agent_id.description: Target agent ID: code-guru (architecture), bug-hunter (debugging), security-hero (security), perf-wizard (performance), doc-king (documentation), qa-tyrant (quality)

task.description: The specific sub-task to delegate to this agent

context.description: Optional context or background information for the sub-task

function.name: terminal
function.description: Run a shell command in the server terminal (cwd = MCP working dir). Returns stdout/stderr/exit code. Windows: PowerShell 5.1; Linux/macOS: bash.

cwd.description: Optional working directory (default: MCP working dir)

function.name: delete_file
function.description: Delete a file or directory (recursive for directories)

path.description: File/directory path (relative to MCP working dir or absolute)

function.name: rename_file
function.description: Rename or move a file/directory

from.description: Source path (relative to MCP working dir or absolute)

to.description: Destination path (relative to MCP working dir or absolute)

function.name: grep
function.description: Search file contents with a regex or plain text pattern inside the MCP working dir (bounded depth). Returns matching file paths + line snippets.

include.description: Optional glob filter, e.g. '**/*.js' or 'src/**' (default: all files)

function.name: glob
function.description: Find files by glob pattern inside the MCP working dir (e.g. '**/*.{js,ts}')

function.name: db_query
function.description: Run a SQL query against a configured database (MySQL/SQLite/PostgreSQL). Config comes from env vars ONLY (DB_TYPE, DB_HOST, DB_PORT, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD, DB_NAME, DB_SQLITE_PATH, DB_TIMEOUT, PHP_BIN). MySQL/PostgreSQL use a PHP PDO bridge (db-bridge.php); SQLite uses Node built-in node:sqlite. Cross-platform (Windows/Linux/macOS).

database.description: Optional DB name override (default: DB_NAME env)

function.name: db_list_tables
function.description: List tables in the configured database (MySQL/SQLite/PostgreSQL). Config from env vars ONLY (DB_*). Cross-platform.

database.description: Optional DB name override (default: DB_NAME env)

function.name: exec
function.description: Run a shell command cross-platform in any folder. Windows uses PowerShell, Linux/macOS uses bash (override via EXEC_SHELL_WIN / EXEC_SHELL_LINUX env). Config from env vars ONLY (EXEC_SHELL_WIN, EXEC_SHELL_LINUX, EXEC_TIMEOUT, EXEC_MAX_BUFFER).

cwd.description: Optional working directory (absolute or relative to MCP working dir)

timeout.description: Optional timeout in ms (default from env EXEC_TIMEOUT, 30000)

env.description: Optional extra environment variables to pass

function.name: http_request
function.description: Make an HTTP request (GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) using Node built-in http/https. No external deps. Config: HTTP_TIMEOUT env (ms). Cross-platform.

timeout.description: Optional timeout in ms (default from env HTTP_TIMEOUT, 30000)

function.name: env_get
function.description: Read an environment variable by name. Config is env-driven (never hardcoded). Values of KEY/SECRET/PASSWORD/TOKEN/AUTH variables are hidden unless reveal_secrets=true.

key.description: Environment variable name (e.g. DB_NAME, PORT, EXEC_TIMEOUT)

reveal_secrets.description: Set true to reveal values of secret-looking variables

function.name: system_info
function.description: Get cross-platform system info: platform, arch, OS, hostname, Node version, cwd, uptime, memory, non-secret env var names, and the configured DB config (values masked).

function.name: remote_mcp_call
function.description: Call a tool on a remote MCP server (outbound MCP client). Use this to invoke tools exposed by connected remote MCP servers.

function.name: ocr__ocr_image
function.description: [external:ocr] Extract text from an image file (PNG, JPG, BMP, TIFF, PDF). Uses Tesseract OCR. Supports Bengali + English.

path.description: Absolute path to the image file

function.name: ocr__ocr_screenshot
function.description: [external:ocr] Take a screenshot of the screen and extract text via OCR. Uses ffmpeg x11grab + Tesseract.

function.name: ocr__ocr_crop
function.description: [external:ocr] Crop a region from an image and extract text. Useful for reading specific parts of screenshots.

function.name: screen-recorder__screen_screenshot
function.description: [external:screen-recorder] Take a screenshot of the entire screen or a specific region. Returns file path.

output.description: Custom output path (optional, auto-generated if empty)

function.name: screen-recorder__screen_record_start
function.description: [external:screen-recorder] Start recording the screen. Returns recording ID. Use screen_record_stop to stop.

duration.description: Max recording duration in seconds (default: 300 = 5 min). Auto-stops.

fps.description: Frames per second (default: 15). Lower = smaller file.

audio.description: Record system audio (default: false). Requires PulseAudio.

function.name: screen-recorder__screen_record_stop
function.description: [external:screen-recorder] Stop the active screen recording. Returns the file path and duration.

recording_id.description: Recording ID to stop (from screen_record_start). If empty, stops the most recent.

function.name: screen-recorder__screen_record_status
function.description: [external:screen-recorder] Check if a screen recording is active. Lists all active recordings.

function.name: tts__tts_speak
function.description: [external:tts] Convert text to speech audio file. Uses Microsoft Edge TTS (free, no API key). Default voice: Bengali female (bn-BD-NabanitaNeural).

function.name: tts__tts_voices
function.description: [external:tts] List available TTS voices. Filter by language.

function.name: tts__tts_play
function.description: [external:tts] Convert text to speech AND play it immediately.
